name: Gearrannan Blackhouse Village
accommodation: Self-catering thatched cottages (a family cottage, a fisherman's cottage and a sea-view blackhouse for one or two), Taigh Làta bunkhouse and Taigh Dhonnchaidh hostel sleeping 10 plus a family room for 3
suitableFor: Couples, families, groups and budget travellers
beachAccess: About 1.5 miles from Dalmore beach (Traigh Dhail Mhor), per the tourism listing
confirmedFeatures: Solid fuel stoves, underfloor heating in some cottages, Wi-Fi, fully equipped hostel kitchen, two hostel shower rooms, drying and laundry facilities, café, shop and museum (seasonal), units adapted for disabled visitors, direct coastal path access
overview: Gearrannan Blackhouse Village is a restored crofting village at Carloway on the west coast of Lewis, about a mile and a half from Dalmore beach. Its thatched cottages, bunkhouse and hostel can be booked all year, and several have solid fuel stoves. A seasonal café, shop and museum sit on site, along with laundry and drying facilities.
surfTripFit: Drying facilities and hostel beds suit a budget surf trip, and Dalmore is only a short drive or walk away.
